decision.scope: This review measures g29-leftover-join.v6 as a CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED leftover-design remasurement that binds NOTHING. It does not SATISFY DR-117, DR-131 or DR-133, does not close leftover-design of OBL-G29-FX-AUTHORING, does not open D-056 Class A, adds no DR-G* row, leaves required-now at 28, and records no recording act. The dispatched g29 leftover-join.v5 Stage A Claude MF-1 is landed in the prescribed shape and D-318 is the sole last-heading claimant; the register-wide two-claimant anomaly now exists only in the frozen predecessor. All 26 cited digests, all six cited commits, the ten-fixture ground truth, the file 08 OPEN token, the D-157 naming parentage and the singleton leftover-design residual reproduce from live bytes. Twenty-two of twenty-two attacks are refuted.
